title: Wrap Index
summary: Return the position that index refers to in a circular list of length items (length is at least 1), from 0 to length - 1. Indexes past the end wrap around to the start, and negative indexes count back from the end: -1 is the last item.
hints: For a non-negative index, the remainder of index divided by length is the answer. Try -1 with your language's remainder operator: does it give 4 or -1 for a length of 5?
In most languages the remainder takes the sign of the dividend, so a negative index gives a negative remainder. Adding length once brings it into range.
TypeScript: -10 % 5 is -0, and the tests tell -0 from 0. ((index % length) + length) % length never returns -0.
